usedFor: Farmbrite holds crops, livestock, orders and contacts, and Calendly makes a booking link through “Create Scheduling Link”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Contact” in Farmbrite, then “Create Scheduling Link” in Calendly
bestTemplate.why: A new contact gets a booking link of their own, so buyers can pick a time to talk.

watchOut: “Create Scheduling Link” only makes the link, so another step must put it in front of the contact.
